cd /app/work && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
from h import *

def one(events, **kw):
    t = trace('a', events, idle_ms=0, **kw)
    r = run({'version':1,'traces':[t]})['results'][0]
    return r

# STREAM direction errors
print('S1', one([dg(0,[pkt('A',0,[F(type='STREAM',id=1,offset=0,data_hex='61',fin=False)])])])['packets'])  # sid%4==1 -> STREAM_STATE_ERROR
print('S2', one([dg(0,[pkt('A',0,[F(type='STREAM',id=5,offset=0,data_hex='61',fin=False)])])])['packets'])
print('S3', one([dg(0,[pkt('A',0,[F(type='STREAM',id=16,offset=0,data_hex='61',fin=False)])])], max_streams_bidi=4)['packets'])  # 16/4+1=5 >4
print('S4', one([dg(0,[pkt('A',0,[F(type='STREAM',id=15,offset=0,data_hex='61',fin=False)])])], max_streams_bidi=4)['packets'])  # 15/4+1=4 ok
print('S5 uni', one([dg(0,[pkt('A',0,[F(type='STREAM',id=8,offset=0,data_hex='61',fin=False)])])], max_streams_uni=2)['packets'])  # 8/4+1=3 >2

# flow control
print('F1', one([dg(0,[pkt('A',0,[F(type='STREAM',id=0,offset=0,data_hex='61'*33,fin=False)])])], max_stream_data=32)['packets'])
print('F2', one([dg(0,[pkt('A',0,[F(type='STREAM',id=0,offset=0,data_hex='61'*32,fin=False)])])], max_stream_data=32)['streams'])
print('F3 conn', one([dg(0,[pkt('A',0,[F(type='STREAM',id=0,offset=0,data_hex='61'*32,fin=False)]),
                          F(type='STREAM',id=4,offset=0,data_hex='61'*33,fin=False))])], max_data=64)
r = one([dg(0,[pkt('A',0,[F(type='STREAM',id=0,offset=0,data_hex='61'*32,fin=False)])]),
         dg(1,[pkt('A',1,[F(type='STREAM',id=4,offset=0,data_hex='61'*33,fin=False)])])], max_data=64)
print('F3', r['packets'], r['received_total'], r['connection'])

# final size
r = one([dg(0,[pkt('A',0,[F(type='STREAM',id=0,offset=0,data_hex='6162',fin=True),
                          F(type='STREAM',id=0,offset=5,data_hex='63',fin=False)])])])
print('FS1', r['packets'], r['connection'])
r = one([dg(0,[pkt('A',0,[F(type='STREAM',id=0,offset=0,data_hex='6162',fin=True),
                          F(type='STREAM',id=0,offset=1,data_hex='63',fin=True)])])])
print('FS2', r['packets'])
r = one([dg(0,[pkt('A',0,[F(type='STREAM',id=0,offset=4,data_hex='',fin=True)])])])
print('FS3', r['packets'], r['streams'])  # zero-length fin at offset 4: end=4, highest=4, final_size=4
r = one([dg(0,[pkt('A',0,[F(type='STREAM',id=0,offset=4,data_hex='61',fin=False),
                          F(type='STREAM',id=0,offset=2,data_hex='6162',fin=True)])])])
print('FS4', r['packets'], r['streams'])
EOF
